title: Fixed-stage rational compositor naturality
statement: Fix scheme maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ and a coefficient stage $L$. The rational compositor $\rho_K:(gf)^*_L K\cong f^*_L g^*_L K$ at $L$, defined as the localization of the selected integral compositor of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition] conjugated by the literal object equalities of rational pullback, is natural in every rational morphism $v:K\to J$ at stage $L$: $\rho_K\circ (gf)^*_L v=f^*_Lg^*_L v\circ\rho_J$ in the order of composition of the category.

proof.text: Every rational morphism is a finite sum of pure tensors $c\otimes a$ with $a$ integral. Rational pullback is additive and sends $c\otimes a$ to $c\otimes$ (integral pullback of $a$) [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations]; the compositor component is $1\otimes$ its integral component. On a pure tensor the square is $c\otimes$ the integral naturality square of the selected compositor [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition]; additivity extends it to all morphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStagePullbackRationalComposition_naturality
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    (L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω)
    {K J : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω Z}
    (hK : K.stage ≤ L) (hJ : J.stage ≤ L)
    (v : K.toStage hK ⟶ J.toStage hJ) :
    (commonStagePullbackRationalComposition l Ω f g L K hK).hom ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).map
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) g).map v) =
      (rationalDerivedPullback l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (f ≫ g)).map v ≫
        (commonStagePullbackRationalComposition l Ω f g L J hJ).hom
